Every piece, one collection, or what a search found, in a grid. The collection chips filter at
once; price, finish, stock and sale wait in a [drawer](/components/dialog/) until "Show", which
says how many pieces it will show. Everything lives in the page's address, so a link shares exactly
this view, and Back returns to the last one.

<Template name="collection" />

## Try it

- Switch collection, or sort by price: the address follows, and Back undoes it.
- Search the bar for `walnut` or `speaker`; search for something that doesn't exist to see the
  empty state.
- Open **Filters**: drag the price [range](/components/slider/), pick a finish, and watch the
  button count the pieces before you apply them.
- Take one filter off from its chip under the toolbar, or all of them at once.

## Details that matter

- **The filters are a row of chips** that scrolls on a phone, and the sort is a
  [select](/components/select/) whose list matches the page.
- **The count says how many pieces are shown,** so a filter never leaves you wondering.
- **Every filter that's on is a chip,** and each one comes off on its own.
- **The drawer never leads nowhere:** when nothing would match, its button says so and waits.
